brief:
British Prime Minister Andy Burnham has engaged an American consulting group that collaborated with the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation, an organization backed by the US and Israel, Middle East Eye reported. The firm was hired as part of Burnham's stated plan to "end neoliberalism," according to the outlet.

The Gaza Humanitarian Foundation has been linked to aid distribution at sites where massacres occurred, the report indicates. Details of the consulting arrangement and the specific scope of the firm's work were not disclosed in the available information.

title: Burnham hires US firm linked to Gaza aid site massacres
